xln.text: Huatli returns to Pachatupa with her dinosaur-riding companion Inti, carrying a captured Legion of Dusk sword after the Sun Empire's last major campaign on the Sun Coast, and presents it to Emperor Apatzec before the crowd. Apatzec privately tells her she will not fight in the south but will guard the eastern coast against a possible Brazen Coalition and Legion attack.

A month later, while burning a Brazen Coalition camp's supplies, Huatli is ambushed by the pirate Angrath, who kills her dinosaur with chains and demands the location of the Immortal Sun. She wounds him in the fight, and in the struggle her planeswalker spark ignites, giving her a glimpse of a golden city before she is pulled back.

Huatli tells the emperor what she saw, and he promises her the title of warrior-poet if she finds the Golden City of Orazca, so she vows to retrieve the Immortal Sun. On the coast she finds the merfolk Tishana, who agrees to guide her, though Tishana later betrays her and abandons her to stop Kumena alone.

Angrath, who has recognized her as another planeswalker, proposes that they escape together by finding the city. At Orazca everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun and a current of energy rushes through them, and Huatli, now able to planeswalk, returns home riding Zacama.

rix.text: Huatli and Angrath watch the golden spires of Orazca climb above the canopy, and she finds the real city more beautiful than she imagined, and nothing like the one in her vision. Angrath shows her a portal to a snowy mountain plane he names Kaldheim, saying that freedom starts with knowing you are trapped, and says they must be near whatever keeps them locked on Ixalan.

They find a bat-marked tomb near Orazca from which Saint Elenda emerges, and Huatli refuses to let the Legion of Dusk take the city. Elenda vanishes, and Angrath attacks Huatli with a chain before running ahead to Orazca.

Huatli and Tishana burst into the Sun chamber, where Vona claims the Immortal Sun for the Legion of Dusk, and all four of them touch it. Through it, Huatli senses the Elder Dinosaurs awaken and calls them to her, then feels Emperor Apatzec's army at the city's edge. When the Sun vanishes along with the barrier, Huatli says Orazca belongs to no one and should be shared.

Back in Pachatupa, Huatli rides in on the elder dinosaur Zacama and tells Apatzec the truth, including that Orazca should no longer be theirs. Apatzec refuses to let her tell that story and decrees there will be no oration at the ceremony, so her family steals the helm of the warrior-poet for her, and Huatli planeswalks to another world to gather stories.

lci.text: Huatli, working with her partner Saheeli, translates tablets in a chamber below Orazca that suggest a huge golden door leads to the birthplace of humanity. Her cousin Inti arrives to say the emperor grows impatient, and Huatli admits she fears more war. When she finishes the translation and slots the tablets in correctly, the golden door cracks open.

Later, Huatli proposes that the Sun Empire and River Heralds cooperate, and she recognizes the pattern on a sealed door as a key, arranging cosmium beads until the door unseals and swings open. The Oltec had sealed the Core off from the world under siege from the Mycotyrant, until Huatli's party arrived.

In the great battle, Huatli screams and dives after her fallen comrade Inti, cradling his dead body as the fight rages above. She kills the vampire Vito with his own lance through the heart, vowing that Inti's name will grace poems while his will gather dust.

Afterward she gives Inti's sword to Wayta, telling him Inti's spirit is an Echo in the gem. Back in the empire, Huatli learns that Atlacan wants to resume his father's war on Torrezon, and she joins Saheeli in backing a plan to depose him and put Caztaca beside the emperor, though Huatli and Saheeli lose their sparks in the Desparkening.
